thread:
Marta Ruiz: Support reported orgs seeing sudden SA quota hits after we auto-migrated old API keys. Looks like attribution changed mid-route.
Noah Patel: I reproduced. Legacy keys without project claims are being mapped to a 'best-fit' SA via sa-map during proxy resolution. That then gets used for quota attribution.
Ellen Brooks: UX problem: console shows SA usage spike with no owner contact details. Customers are surprised.
Victor Han: quick mitigation: add an `X-Auth-Provenance` header with values `claim|header|sa-map|legacy-default` so console + billing can show why attribution happened.
Marta Ruiz: agreed. Also mark billing events from non-asserted attributions as `provisional=true` so we don't finalize charges until reconciliation window (48h).
Noah Patel: implementation: auth returns `X-Resolved-Origin: sa:svc-123` and `X-Auth-Provenance: sa-map`. Gateway preserves both. Quota service will treat provenance!=claim as provisional.
Ellen Brooks: console change: show a small badge "inferred" next to usage rows with hover text and link to support flow. Also add an events column for provenance.
Victor Han: telemetry: emit counter `auth.provenance_total{method=...}` and a list of affected tenants for targeted notices.
ci-bot: build queued: auth-provenance -> staging (build #2142).
Marta Ruiz: rollout: feature flag on auth + provisional billing path. Start 5% canary, watch `auth.provenance_total{method=sa-map}` and billing deltas. We'll reconvene after staging metrics.
